'''SN-4RK''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromench droid]] and [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who sold cybernetic implants on [[Carrick Station]] on behalf of [[Lonndar Eadwinn]].<ref name="TOR:TE" />

==Behind the scenes==
*SN-4RK is a Legendary Implants vendor. They appear on both Carrick Station and [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR:TE" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'' {{1st}}
